crossRefs.note: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his…
He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…

translations.web: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
translations.bsb: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
translations.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
translations.asv: Let not thy heart decline to her ways; Go not astray in her paths.
